intro: Convert knots (kn) to miles per hour (mph) accurately for marine wind speed forecasts, aviation true airspeed, and sailing logs. When comparing a knot vs miles per hour, 1 international knot equals 1 nautical mile per hour (1.852 km/h), which equals approximately 1.15077945 mph—roughly 15% faster than 1 mph. Enter any wind or vessel speed above, or jump straight to a reading in our knots-to-mph wind and navigation chart below.
alsoWrittenAs: kn to mph, kt to mph, kts to mph, nautical miles per hour to mph

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Nautical Miles per Hour vs. Statute Miles per Hour
items: A knot already incorporates 'per hour' (1 knot = 1 nautical mile per hour = 1.852 km/h); saying 'knots per hour' is redundant for speed.
A quick mental rule multiplies knots by 1.15 (or adds 15%), which stays within 0.1% across sailing speeds—though 1.15077945 should be used for high-speed aviation.

faqs.question: How many miles per hour (mph) are in 1 knot?
faqs.answer: There are 1.15077945 miles per hour (mph) in 1 knot (about 1.151 mph). To convert knots to mph, multiply the speed in knots by 1.15077945.

faqs.question: What is the difference between knots and miles per hour?
faqs.answer: Both measure speed, but a knot equals 1 nautical mile per hour (1.852 km/h, based on 1 arcminute of Earth's latitude), whereas miles per hour (mph) uses 1 statute mile per hour (1.609344 km/h). Because a nautical mile is longer, 1 knot is about 15.08% faster than 1 mph.

faqs.question: What is 50 knots in miles per hour?
faqs.answer: 50 knots (kn) equals 57.53897 miles per hour (mph), or roughly 57.5 mph.
